Name: Rory NPC - a friend for Ariah (Ridgeside Village)
Author: arcadiabays
Description:
THIS IS AN UNFINISHED MOD!!! I no longer have time to work on this, but I figured I'd post what I have so far in case anyone wanted to work on it or use it as is. I would LOVE if anyone better at modding finished it up for me, if you do, please leave a comment with your version! Best of luck everyone!

Rory is a nonbinary teenager sent to live with the Amethyne family on day 20 of Spring. I really wanted Ariah to have a friend that could teach her to relax and would stand up to her grandmother. Rory was the result! 

They currently have three heart events and dialogue for every day. They have a custom schedule. They do not appear at events. Ariah's schedule is also affected by some of Rory's events!

They have a portrait made by the Stardew Portrait Creator by Jazzybee and Poltergeister, found [url=http://https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator]here[/url].

Please feel free to modify this mod and upload it with improved events if you feel so moved. Ideas I had for future heart events include one where you advise them on their transition, one where you talk about their feelings for Ariah, and one where you talk about their desire to be an artist instead of a businessperson. 

Thanks for reading!
